The '''CG1XB Translator Module''' was a piece of technology that, when installed in other [[Droid/Legends|droids]] allowed [[4XB Programmer Droid]]s to program other the units using complex electronic sound patterns.<ref name="EBB">{{JournalCite|1|Escape from Balis-Baurgh}}</ref>
